audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer credited Ziggs's wave-zoning to his W in six places — 'stacks W bombs on the wave', 'His W-spam zoning', 'Spam W onto the minion wave', 'Q-W combos', 'his W bomb zone', 'spam W on the wave'. W is Satchel Charge: a 20/18/16/14/12s knockback and escape that also hexplodes turrets. The mine-field zoning tool is Hexplosive Minefield (E), 900 range, flat 16s. Nothing about W is spammable — 20s and 80 mana at rank 1.
audit.why: enemyKit W and E texts are unambiguous, and the packet flags that the matchup 'never names any of Ziggs's abilities'.
audit.corrected: Hexplosive Minefield named as the zoning tool in whys[1], spikes[0].text, wants.foe[0], wants.you[0] and early; Bouncing Bomb (850, 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s) named as the poke; Satchel Charge kept as the escape it actually is.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Ziggs/Ziggs/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill while the content layer and packet levelChart read Ziggs/Ziggs/Ziggs/Ziggs/Azir/Azir/Azir — five rows rendering two answers.
audit.why: 44.27% over 436 games: Ziggs owns the early lane on range, and the flip at 6 is real because Ziggs has no dash in his kit at all, so Emperor's Divide behind him removes his only exit once Satchel Charge is spent.
audit.corrected: phases[2..3].side moved to Ziggs and phases[4..6].side to Azir; those five whys rewritten to match.

audit.why: Spike order holds: Ziggs owns 3-5 on Hexplosive Minefield, Azir's level 6 Emperor's Divide is the inflection against a champion with no mobility, Nashor's widens it. Grounded with real cooldowns rather than replaced.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states WHY 6 flips it — Ziggs has no dash, so the wall is lethal.
sources: enemyKit (no dash flag on any ability)

audit.why: It is the field that exists to hold cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Satchel Charge 20s, Hexplosive Minefield flat 16s, Bouncing Bomb 6s, Azir E 22s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED); dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d also did not match their titles.
audit.why: Each title promises an action the body never explained.
audit.corrected: Five bodies rewritten to their own titles using Ziggs's ranges, cooldowns and mana costs.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions carries a 'resistances-invalidated' rule saying Satchel Charge bypasses stacking resistances, and a 'autoreset-burst-tell' rule for Short Fuse.
audit.why: The Short Fuse tell is real and is now stated (phases[0].why). The Satchel Charge percent-health/resistance claim is NOT in Riot's text — 'The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away' — so the derived percentHealth flag looks like a tooltip-parsing misfire. Per the brief, the description wins over the flag.
audit.corrected: Short Fuse's empowered auto added; the resistance-bypass claim deliberately NOT written anywhere. Recorded as unverified.

edits.before: W a soldier behind the wave and farm THROUGH it — your auto range is the soldier's range. Don't poke yet; sand costs mana.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb is 850 range and Short Fuse empowers his auto. W behind the wave, farm through it, spend no mana yet.

edits.before: Two soldiers up means a real trade: W-Q the drag-through and step back. The poke is free only when his engage is down.
edits.after: Two soldiers let you drag a Q through him, but Satchel Charge knocks you away on 20s. Trade once, then step off.

edits.before: E completes the safety net — you now have the shield-dash out. Greedier soldier placements are allowed, not encouraged.
edits.after: E is your shield-dash out, but Hexplosive Minefield covers 900 range on 16s and slows — do not walk into the mines.

edits.before: Nashor's components arrive and the soldier DPS starts to sting. Drag Qs through Ziggs on every last-hit he takes.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 on a 5s cooldown at rank 3 and clears the wave. Farm behind the sand and take the chip.

edits.before: Emperor's Divide online — the dive insurance and the insec flip. With R up you win every 2v2 your jungler joins.
edits.after: Emperor's Divide online: Ziggs has no dash at all, so a wall behind him is a dead Ziggs. The lane flips here.

edits.before: Nashor's spike: your soldier poke becomes shred. Shove crashes and rotate — the soldiers siege towers better than any mid.
edits.after: Nashor's spike: soldier poke becomes shred. Crash waves and force a champion with no mobility to answer you at 525.

edits.before: Full build Azir is a teamfight: R cuts the fight in half, soldiers melt whoever is on your side of the wall.
edits.after: Full build your wall cuts off his only escape, and soldiers delete a Ziggs who cannot leave the zone.

edits.before: Ziggs wins by landing Satchel Charge, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Ziggs mines the ground with Hexplosive Minefield, chips you at 850 with Bouncing Bomb, then satchels out when you step.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - E Shifting Sands is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1: it knocks you away and is his only escape, so step up while it is down. - Hexplosive Minefield is a flat 16s and Bouncing Bomb 6s. - E Shifting Sands (22s) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Place the soldier past him, Q it back through his body as he steps up for a minion, then retreat off the mines.

edits.before: W behind the wave, Q-drag the soldier through Ziggs on his last-hit, auto once through the soldier, step back — two-second trades he cannot answer without overextending.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 and Hexplosive Minefield 900, but neither follows you: hold the far side of the sand, let the soldier poke, and step out of the mine field.

edits.before: Ziggs spends Satchel Charge early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Q costs 110 mana at rank 5 while Bouncing Bomb clears the wave for 50 — you run out first.

edits.before: That’s Ziggs’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Every whiffed soldier costs 40 mana and buys him another free Bouncing Bomb.

edits.before: Standing at max soldier range admiring your poke with E on cooldown — that is the engage window every Ziggs player is waiting for.
edits.after: Mega Inferno Bomb reaches 5000 units, so shoving past river without flank wards means it lands on you from a screen away.

edits.before: Ahead, siege: crash waves with soldier autos, take every plate, and rotate to river with R held — your wall converts even fights into massacres.
edits.after: Ahead, siege: crash with soldier autos, take plates while Satchel Charge's 20 seconds is down, and rotate with R held to wall off his only escape.

edits.before: Carry through siege control — soldiers take plates, R denies engages, and your DPS curve outlasts every assassin spike in the lobby.
edits.after: Carry through siege — soldiers take plates, and Emperor's Divide traps a champion with no dash where your sand can reach him.

edits.before: If Ziggs takes first blood, tighten up: Satchel Charge is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm at soldier range and stay relevant through wave control.
edits.after: If Ziggs takes first blood, tighten up: assume Satchel Charge is up and never step into the mines. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn't — farm at soldier range and hold R for his escape.

edits.before: His W-spam zoning is fully online and Azir has no ultimate yet to punish the aggression
edits.after: His Hexplosive Minefield zoning is fully online and Azir has no ultimate yet to punish it

edits.before: Ziggs stacks W bombs on the wave and can zone you off farm entirely from beyond your soldier range, forcing you to eat CS losses or risk a stray Q.
edits.after: Ziggs lays Hexplosive Minefield across the wave and zones you off farm entirely from beyond your soldier range, forcing CS losses or a stray Bouncing Bomb to the face.

edits.before: Spam W onto the minion wave to zone you off CS and chip your health
edits.after: Lay Hexplosive Minefield on the wave to zone you off CS and chip you

edits.before: Poke with Q-W combos whenever you're forced to last-hit
edits.after: Poke with Bouncing Bomb whenever you're forced to last-hit

edits.before: Farm with soldiers from max range, don't walk up into his W bomb zone
edits.after: Farm with soldiers from max range, never walk into his Hexplosive Minefield

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are already tough as Ziggs's bomb range outpokes your early soldier trades, but it truly bites levels 3-5 when he can spam W on the wave and threaten a Q-W combo the instant you step up to farm. Play a freeze near your tower, let minions do the last-hitting, and just survive the poke rather than contest it directly.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are already tough as Bouncing Bomb's 850 range outpokes your early soldier trades, but it truly bites levels 3-5 when Hexplosive Minefield covers the wave on a flat 16 seconds and threatens a follow-up the instant you step up to farm. Play a freeze near your tower, let minions do the last-hitting, and survive the poke rather than contest it.
